Entry White Harbor as the Northern Sea Outlet White Harbor freed the North from having to rely entirely on the long overland route. The Manderly family's harbor, warehouses and merchant ships exchanged grain, timber, furs and exotic luxuries on the same wharf; northern lords saw it as a gateway to wealth and news, and sailors knew Seal Bay's origins. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.
